entries.name: Louis Octave GENDRON
entries.source: Ancestry original registers, census and notarial repertory
entries.outcome: 16 November 2026 — Ancestry tree-led original record review: Gunnis tree supplied an 1848 notarial repertory and 1861 Barford census lead. Original 1827 baptism read: Louis Octave, born the previous day, son of Jean Baptiste Gendron, menuisier, and Archange Poulin. Original 1826 parents’ marriage read: Jean Baptiste, son of deceased Michel Gendron and Elizabeth Normand, and Archange Poulin, daughter of Joseph Poulin and Marie Louise Chicoine. Original 1834 remarriage names Jean Baptiste as widower of Lucie Poulin, marrying Lucie Dudevoir; the Lucie/Archange difference is retained. Notarial repertory: 20 April 1848, Jean-Baptiste Maranda no. 1291, quittance et ratification by Louis Octave Gendron to Jean Baptiste Gendron; full minute not inspected, kinship not stated in the repertory. Original 1861 census, Barford, Stanstead, p. 21, C-1323, lines 40–50: Jean Bte Jondro 62, Lucy 46, Alfred 21, Edward 19, difficult given name indexed Itan 34 unmarried, John B 26, Peter 17, Virginia 15, Mary 13, Julan 10, Delia 3 born USA. Original Alfred marriage, Compton 1 August 1864, confirms parents Jean Baptiste Gendron and Lucie Dudevoir of Barford. Candidate moved to likely elimination on combined family/age evidence; not solid. The tree’s 1871 McNider Octave 45 is married to Vitaline and listed near Prudent Gendron/Henriette Chamard; not adopted as C199. Its 1881 continuation was not inspected.

entries.name: Joseph GENDRON
entries.source: Ontario death original and Châteauguay census comparison
entries.outcome: Read original Ontario death registration 015312, John Joseph Gendron, 28 June 1906, Frontenac, age 75, married farmer, born Province of Quebec; registered 29 June 1906. The form does not name parents or spouse. Ancestry suggests the Kennebec Joseph/Mary Ann Clark census trail and a church index naming this couple as parents of William Joseph; the suggestion is not an identity proof. Original 1861 St-Joachim-de-Châteauguay census p.82, line 17, reel C-1274, viewer 50/359, lists unmarried Joseph Gendron, 31, near Antoine Gendron, 42, Adelaide Hebert, 34, Pelery/Pélagie Gendron, 26, and Louis Gendron, 68. This does not establish Antoine Gendron/Marie Anne Lefebvre as Joseph’s parents. Exact-name Drouin search Joseph Gendron, father Antoine, mother surname Lefebvre, without a birth year, returned the 1829 baptism only; no younger same-parent Joseph was verified. Name reuse is not used as elimination evidence. Suggested Yamachiche baptism 7 May 1830 names Francois Gendron/Marie Pellerin and is a separate record, not an established identification of the Ontario man. Needs work unchanged.

entries.name: Louis Octave GENDRON
entries.source: Original maternal burial and marriage transcription correction
entries.outcome: Re-read original 11 April 1826 Verchères marriage, M19: Archange Poulin is daughter of deceased Joseph Poulin and Marie Louise Chicoine. The 1861 census given name was re-examined at higher magnification and remains retained as a difficult reading, indexed Itan. Re-read 1848 repertory: quittance et ratification by sieur Ls Octave Gendron to sieur Jean Bte Gendron; it does not state father–son. Read 1855 Southbridge census index for John B Gendron 55/Lucy 39 and children John B20, Melvinia 19, Delina 17, Alfred 15, Edward 14, Peter 13, Verginia 11, Lucy 9, Jule 6; Louis Octave is not in that indexed household.
